name: rules.operation

list.description: List operation rules with full native fields.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Exact case-sensitive local ruleStatus match; repeat for alternatives. Never sent to the backend; refresh retains the full native scope.

get.description: Query native detail by ruleId; reads online without changing the saved list.

lookup.name: ruleId

result_identity.description: Native detail ruleId identity; validated against the requested ruleId.

purpose: Inspect operation rules through their native inquiry without changing configuration.

fields.name: ruleId
fields.meaning: Native record identity; original JSON type is retained.

fields.name: ruleStatus
fields.meaning: Native rule status used by the exact local status filter.

identity_description: Native ruleId identifies each record; no synthetic identity is created.
limitations: Fixed native pageSize=1000; rowStart offsets start at zero.
Native endpoint has no page echoes. Completeness requires fixed total, arrival and unique identity agreement.
Unknown fields, native JSON types and exact decimal values are retained.
Pinned v0.4.3 provides contract provenance; current production qualification is recorded separately.
status filters exact native ruleStatus locally after acquisition. Repeated values select alternatives without duplicate output; filtered refresh saves the full scope.
Native detail uses GET query /riskActionRuleDetail.json; sends ruleId as a string with GUAPW3SG tenant.
Detail returns one native root response; separate histories, logs and child pages are not queried.

List with --live --with-detail fetches detail only for the selected offset/limit window as separate record/detail members; any detail failure fails the whole query. Get and combined queries preserve the saved List.
